description: Java source file defining a REST API resource for self-service loan products in the Fineract platform. It includes API endpoints for retrieving all loan products and specific loan product details, with validation and delegation to underlying services.

classes.name: SelfLoanProductsApiResource
classes.description: REST resource exposing endpoints related to self-service loan products, with validation and delegation to underlying APIs.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanProducts

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductDetails
